schema.description: Leased external-service registration advertised through the OpenRemote Manager.

homepageUrl.description: Absolute URL of the service UI or configuration page.

icon.description: Material Design Icons name used by Manager UIs.

instanceId.description: Instance number assigned by the Manager during registration.

isGlobal.description: Whether the service is visible to every realm.

serviceId.description: Stable identifier shared by all instances of the same service.

status.description: Current availability derived from the registration lease.

schema.title: ExternalService

401.description: Authentication is required or the supplied credentials are invalid

403.description: The authenticated user does not have permission to perform this operation
